mechanism: Triamcinolone may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of guanfacine through sodium retention and fluid accumulation caused by corticosteroid effects, while guanfacine may potentiate corticosteroid-induced hyperglycemia and immunosuppression.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and glycemic control; adjust guanfacine dosing if needed; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose and duration.
